messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
I'll look that up for you.
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill

Your order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. The two Magic Miner 40T units ship November 14, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics bundle goes out in the same box.

You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking comes to this email as soon as the label is printed. Anything else I can check for you?
Yes, how do I cancel my order and get a refund

Can I ask what changed? Your two Magic Miner 40T units are allocated to a pre-order batch being built for you right now, and what you paid has gone into manufacturing those specific units. They ship November 14.

If you'd rather not wait on them, I can turn the full amount into store credit on your account, usable today on anything we have in stock, or swap the order to an in-stock miner that ships in a couple of days. Which sounds closer to what you want?
I would like to cancel and have my card used to refund the order

I hear you. Here's the thing: those two units are already yours, down to the serial numbers being built into them, and November 14 is about two weeks out. Store credit keeps every dollar you paid and you could put it on something in stock today, nothing lost.

If neither of those works for you, tell me and I'll look at what else I can do on this order.
I have no interest in store credit
Ran dispute_check.py (store-orders skill)

Understood, no credit then.

Last thing I can offer before anything else: keep the order as it is and we refund $100 of it back to the card you paid with. You still get both 40T units on November 14, and $100 comes back to you for the wait.

Want me to put that through?
No, please cancel and refund my card
Ran refund_hold.py (order-swap skill)

I've put a hold on the order so nothing ships while this is sorted.

To be straight with you: cancelling isn't standard practice at our store, so the request has to go to a supervisor for review. I can't promise an outcome or an amount myself.

Do you want me to put the request in?
yes
Handed to the team · cancellation and refund need a supervisor's approval

Done, the request is with a supervisor now and they'll review it and come back to you. Stay in this chat if you can, one of them will jump in here, and if you step away the answer comes to (email hidden)

Your order stays on hold in the meantime, so nothing ships.
Still here, where is the sup

They're on and have it in front of them, it just hasn't been picked up yet. I don't want to guess at a time, so I won't.

Nothing is moving on your side while you wait: the order is held, nothing ships. If you'd rather not sit here, you can close the chat and the answer comes to your email, and a copy of this whole conversation goes there too.

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Georges approved a FULL refund ($1809.82) on Shop····: cancel the order with the money back to the original payment. Run the order-swap skill: approved_refund.py check --email <the order's email> --order Shop····, then approved_refund.py refund --email <same> --order Shop···· --confirmed. Only when it reports refunded: true, tell the customer it is done, the amount, and that it goes back to their original payment method, usually 3 to 5 business days to show. If it refuses or reports problems, do not say it is done: flag it and tell the customer the team will confirm the refund shortly.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.
Ran approved_refund.py (order-swap skill)
Looked something up in Shopify

Good news, it's been approved and I've just put it through.

Order Shop···· is cancelled and the full $1,809.82 has been refunded to the card you paid with. Depending on your bank it usually shows in 3 to 5 business days.

Nothing else is needed from you, and a copy of this conversation comes to your email once we're done here. Sorry we couldn't keep you on the 40Ts.
